methodology: Default inference mode;20 independent anchoredchunks;two steps;identical inputs/output hash.
Historical times are performance results;Nsight captures are diagnostics and have overhead.
NVTX sampler/decode boundaries synchronize their CUDA context. CUDA activity spans establish actual kernel overlap.
GPU counters are sampled at1000Hz;SM activity is not equivalent to peak compute utilization.
Kernel durations and per-process API durations overlap;their sums are not video wall time.
Targeted NCU replays characterize selected kernels;they do not preserve the full MPS pipeline schedule.
